description: Inbox is a shared inbox and CRM platform for managing team conversations and outreach across messaging platforms such as Twitter/X. It lets teams read messages, manage contacts and threads, and automate campaign and follow-up workflows.
summary: Inboxapp exposes one authenticated REST API at https://inboxapp.com/api/v2 and one OAuth/API-token-authenticated MCP server at https://mcp.inboxapp.com/mcp; no GraphQL API or CLI was found.
